scope: Read-only coefficient magnitude inventory. No rewards, raw step ledgers, or in-progress main-run outputs were used.

definitions.parent_norm: Frobenius norm of the stored nine-coefficient shared matrix, regardless of binding state.
definitions.current_candidate_norm: Frobenius norm of the next decision's mean effective 27-coefficient candidate. Its source pair is the final two outcome bout metadata rows before the checkpoint; the pair is matched to current resident task generations and reconstructed from saved core arrays. Bout reward fields are not read into the diagnostic record or used.
definitions.last_candidate_matrix: The most recent transient candidate matrix is not persisted in calibration/comparison checkpoints. Its provenance is tested against current resident generations; exact reconstruction is reported only if both sources still match.
definitions.early_late: Earliest and latest persisted decision checkpoints available per stream, rather than chosen decision thresholds.
